✦ PROJECT-LOCAL / USER-OWNED

Give every directory a way of working of its own.

New to AI? You do not need a perfect prompt. Put your material in one folder and tell an agent the first thing you want to do. Qiming helps it understand the workspace and leave a clear place to continue.

See installation ↗Explore an example ↗

Qiming applies only to the project you explicitly adopt. Installing the seed does not automatically manage your computer or other folders.

PROJECT-LOCAL · Q/01
※

Change agents or computers without explaining your work from scratch.

When Qiming helps

Use it for work that continues over time: scattered material, changing agents or computers, and a need to resume from real progress. A software project, manuscript, website, or local AI setup can each start in one folder.

  • You need to recover the last verified state
  • You maintain projects, services, works, or tools
  • You want to separate completion from real verification

When to keep it simple

For a one-off answer, translation, or file lookup, just do the task. Qiming does not automatically control other folders and does not replace specialist tools, real acceptance, or your authorization for risky actions.

  • The task ends after one answer
  • You expect installation to control every device
  • You would treat records as backups or monitoring
